يعتقلون (form VIII)
# يَعْتَقِلُونَ (yaʕtaqilūna) /jaʕ.ta.qi.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# يُعْتَقَلُونَ (yuʕtaqalūna) /juʕ.ta.qa.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
